title: Report Bibliography: Defense Documentation Center, DoD Instruction 5100.38, July 1, 1969
doc_notes: This document is a report bibliography from the Defense Documentation Center listing various technical reports and studies related to UAP/UFOs, including the Condon Committee reports.

incidents.summary: Study of observers reporting a light in the night sky as stationary when it was actually moving, a phenomenon termed autostasis.
behavior: moving continuously along a linear course
incidents.quote: THREE OF FIVE OBSERVERS OF A LIGHT IN THE NIGHT SKY THAT WAS ACTUALLY MOVING CONTINUOUSLY ALONG A LINEAR COURSE REPORTED IT AS STATIONARY
